headline: Does he really love me?
note: Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework, after the interior ban was loosened. The read may now ANSWER: the card carries the claim about him. 🔴 THE DENIAL IS STILL BANNED — 'he does not love you' is the one direction she has no use for. 🔴 NO DIAGNOSIS: avoidant, emotionally unavailable, commitment-phobic, narcissist. 🔴 Never grade her (naive, foolish, gave too much). 🔴 No dates. The seven cuts run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why / let me look closer — and every cut must add information the last one did not carry.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the wand in his hand is white and lifted above the roses.
You asked whether the love is really love. Your hand went to the card of what a man does.
So yes, dear. What you've been given is real love.
And a man like this does nothing by halves. He knew what he was building with you.
But building it and saying it out loud are two different jobs for him.
That's why you got the care, dear, and never quite got the words.
Let me look closer at what keeps the words from coming…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the rope holds and the tree keeps growing round it.
You asked whether the love is really love. Your hand went to the card of a thing held in place.
So the love is real, dear. What you've been given is not in doubt.
And he knows he's stuck there. That's the part he has never said out loud.
But he can't get himself down from there just by knowing it.
That's why nothing moves, dear, however warm he is with you.
Let me look closer at what has been holding that rope in place…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — he holds the flower up, not down.
You asked if he really loves you. Your hand went to the card of an open heart.
So it's real, dear. What he gives you, he gives freely.
And nothing in this card is weighed out or held back on purpose.
But a heart this open has not worked out where it's going yet.
That's why he can be warm with you, dear, and still name nothing.
Let me look closer at what stops him putting a name to it…
